import sys

def main():
    input_line = sys.stdin.readline().strip()
    tmp = input_line.split(" ")
    w = int(tmp[0])
    m = int(tmp[1])
    ok = True
    all = []
    
    while m != 0:
        all.append(m % w)
        m //= w
    
    for i in range(len(all)):
        if all[i] == 0 or all[i] == 1:
            continue
        if all[i] == w - 1:
            j = i + 1
            while j < len(all):
                if all[j] == w - 1:
                    all[j] = 0
                else:
                    all[j] = all[j] + 1
                    break
                j += 1
            continue
        ok = False
        break
    
    if ok:
        print("YES")
    else:
        print("NO")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
